surface: Antigravity IDE 2.5.5 (VS Code fork 1.107.0, antigravity extension 0.2.0) running interactively on macOS Darwin 25.6.0 arm64. Local language server daemon language_server_macos_arm (ide-2.4.5) communicates via loopback IPC to Electron (PID 64171, port 62662) and HTTPS to Google backend (https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com). Attended IDE chat/agent surface with local shell/file execution.

open_questions: Does agentapi new-conversation support an explicit workspace root argument or flags for non-interactive execution, or does it strictly inherit the working directory of the caller?
Where does the Google backend log actual prompt and candidate token counts for IDE sessions, and can a researcher obtain them via Cloud Console / Cloud Code audit logs?
Can the 5 global plugins in ~/.gemini/config/plugins/ be selectively disabled via environment variable or workspace configuration without physically removing them from disk?
Can the Antigravity Python SDK (google-antigravity) run against the existing local language server daemon (localhost:62669) without requiring a separate GEMINI_API_KEY?
Does Antigravity support an immutable backend snapshot pinning mechanism (e.g. specifying a dated model revision string in agentapi or IDE settings)?
What are the precise semantics and billing attribution of the internal Cloud Code endpoint https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com (Google internal quota vs Google Cloud project billing)?
